gate: Levi-Civita Sector Closure Under Retained Operations Gate

source_insertion.law: global exponential/log-density tilt rho_s=exp(log rho+s P_A)/Z, source coordinate not time

small_source_scaling.interpretation: In this symmetric weak-correlation control both defects begin approximately at second order in source strength; the QTC/nonmetricity coefficient is much larger. Their common order does not imply a constitutive relation, and the earlier independence of metric and solder/holonomy channels remains.

source_insertion.theorem: Generic state-changing source insertion is not tangent to the LC sector. It regenerates nonmetricity and, with fixed RESA in this control, also regenerates solder nonclosure. The two defects are distinct observables and need not have the same magnitude or behavior in other sectors.

independent_composition.theorem: Strict disjoint composition preserves the sector componentwise because no cross-interface incidence is created.

q_isometry_groupoid.theorem: q-isometric transports are closed under composition; unconstrained intermediate metrics leave the groupoid.

refinement.theorem: LC-compatible refinements exist but are not selected by current generic refinement freedom.

atlas_gauge.theorem: Pure chart/frame gauge preserves sector membership; atlas closure alone does not constrain physical inserted metrics/solder.

preserving_subcategory.name: LCM — Levi-Civita Morphisms
preserving_subcategory.definition: retained morphisms that jointly intertwine the selected score metric and preserve solder covariant closure/refinement on every affected incidence
preserving_subcategory.meaning: the LC sector is a genuine subcategory, not isolated points, but the full current retained operation category is larger

missing_law.name: LCSP — Levi-Civita Sector Preservation Law
missing_law.statement: Operations acting within the Einstein-compatible sector must lift jointly to state/score metric, transport, and solder so Q=0 and continuum T=0 (or its discrete precursor) are preserved.

generic_source_log_density_insertion.preserves_Tlike: not guaranteed; broken at finite source in executed control

next_gate.name: LCSP Origin / Source-Compatible Levi-Civita Morphism Gate
next_gate.question: Classify infinitesimal source deformations tangent to Q=0 and the torsion-free sector. Test whether PGRL/source-current compatibility automatically satisfies those tangent constraints, or whether LCSP is an independent superselection law on allowed source operations.
